note: stable is the reference verdict: the brute-force scan's where there is one (tm_min > -1e-10), otherwise thermo's FlashVL (one phase). thermo holds FlashVL's result at PT_SS_TOL 1e-30; witness_tm is the lowest tm of its phases against the feed. tm is normalised: sum w_i(ln w_i + ln phi_i(w) - d_i).
